text:
tess: Hey @support — ACME (tenant acme-prod-42) started getting 429s and huge tail latency right after we migrated them into dedicated pool `quiet-pool-12` ~2026-03-15T18:12Z. They see lots of `rate_limited` responses with `retry_after: 0`. Can someone triage quickly?

maya: On it. Do you have an example request id or a short log snippet? Also did they change plan or request?

tess: Paste from their client (timestamped):
```
2026-03-15T18:13:02Z request_id=aa7b1c tenant=acme-prod-42 status=429 body={"code":"rate_limited","retry_after":0}
2026-03-15T18:13:03Z request_id=aa7b1d tenant=acme-prod-42 status=200 latency_ms=5120 model=gpt-xl-4
2026-03-15T18:13:04Z request_id=aa7b1e tenant=acme-prod-42 status=429 body={"code":"rate_limited","retry_after":0}
```

tess: They say the 200s have huge token latency (2.5-5s per token) intermittently.

maya: Quick check on the quota service metrics — I see a hard drop in the per-tenant token budget for acme-prod-42 right at the migration time. Expected sustained rate ~5000 units/min but effective allowance is ~500 units/min. That fits 429s with retry_after 0. Pulling the tenant config now.

maya: tenant config snapshot (from config-db at 18:12):
```
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-prod-42",
  "pool": "quiet-pool-12",
  "quota": {
    "burst": 500,
    "rate": 500,
    "window": 60,
    "units": "seconds"
  }
}
```

maya: Looks like the migration wrote `units: "seconds"` where the old system used `minutes` semantics. The quota service interprets `rate` as X units per `units` window -> this effectively reduced their allowed tokens by ~60x.

ryan: Yep that's consistent with the spike in 429s. Repro steps I ran locally:
1) Create tenant with `rate: 500, window: 60, units: seconds` -> immediate 429s under normal load.
2) Change units to `minutes` or multiply rate by 60 -> normal.

ryan: Repro curl (use our staging quota service):
```
# simulate tenant rapid requests
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: acme-prod-42" \
    -d '{"prompt":"test"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate &
done
```
With broken units you'll see ~60% 429s instantly.

cheng: Short-term mitigation options:
- apply a temporary per-tenant override (set `rate` = `rate` * 60) via admin console (fast)
- enable fallback routing from `quiet-pool-12` to `shared-hosted` for the tenant to avoid 429s while we fix migration (needs routing tweak)
- increase autoscaler aggressiveness on `quiet-pool-12` so noisy neighbor effect is reduced during backpressure

maya: I'm going to apply a temporary override + create a ticket for a permanent migration rollback/fix.

ops-bot: Created incident ticket INC-1234: "acme-prod-42 quota misinterpreted units after dedicated migration" and paged eng-runtime on-call.

maya: Override applied at 18:22Z: set `rate`=30000 (was 500), `burst`=30000. Monitoring now.

tess: Customer reports error rate dropped to ~1% within ~2 minutes, latency back to normal for the baseline requests. They appreciate the quick fix but want root cause and permanent fix.

ryan: Root cause summary: migration utility wrote `units=seconds` instead of `minutes` when translating older quota objects. Fix plan:
- patch migration script to preserve legacy `minutes` semantics (divide stored rate by 60 or mark units correctly)
- write DB migration to correct affected tenants (script + dry run)
- add validation in quota-service to reject suspiciously low rates (alert on >=10x deviation)
- add an e2e test for quota unit semantics in the migration pipeline

cheng: I'll also relax `quiet-pool-12` autoscaler thresholds for the next 24h and enable the fallback route for any tenant showing >5% 429s.

maya: Assigning follow up: @ryan to own migration patch + PR, @cheng to own autoscaler/routing changes, @maya to coordinate customer comms and confirm DB migration dry run.

ryan: Will push a patch today and open PR with tests. ETA for prod fix & DB migration: 48 hours after review.

ops-bot: INC-1234 updated: severity=high, assignees=[ryan, cheng, maya].

tess: Customer confirmed service stable at 18:27Z, asked for a postmortem. I'll draft one after root cause fix is deployed. 

maya: Good catch. Adding quick note to the postmortem: consider adding explicit unit field in the quota UI to avoid ambiguity (:eyes:).

ryan: I'll include the repro script and the failing migration snippet in the PR.

cheng: Marking this thread resolved for now. Will re-open if we see recurrence. :white_check_mark:
